citation_rules.span: the context source `context`, locator `line:N` (splitlines of the file's bytes), source_sha256 = sha256 of the file bytes
citation_rules.key_value_quote: when the field has its own line (the stripped line is the key/value text, one trailing comma allowed) and the text is unique in that line: `"rating": "BB"` (form layout)
citation_rules.object_anchored_quote: else the text from the row object's `{` through the cited value when that is one line and unique in it (a minified file: `{"agency":"S&P","scope":"issuer","rating":"BB"`, locator line:1)
citation_rules.none: else no citation: the named issue `Context rating row <n> (<agency>) cannot be cited as one unique span; ratings not used`
citation_rules.fields: agency -> agency value; instrument `Not stated`, rating, and a `Not stated` outlook or date -> the rating value; outlook -> outlook value; date -> as_of value
citation_rules.derived: a derived fact (position, notches, lower_rated, outlook_match, first_agency, second_agency) has one citation per (source, locator): the first of its inputs' citations on it, in input order (cases/cp2h-owner/builder/build.py lineage rule, rulings stage2 round 3 item 3); position derives from its rating fact and has no scale citation
citation_rules.terms: T2R.3 and everything derived from it cite ratings page:3, as before, with the renamed quotes

own_limitations_rule: frozen list; [0] and [6] replaced by the context lines; then, directly after the eight fixed lines and before the frozen threshold-not-stated, withdrawn, not-calculable and Gap lines: the fixed-table line, one `The rating date is not stated for <agency>.` per empty as_of (row order), one `Rating scope: <scope> (<agency>).` per row (row order). The order is the preparer's reading of plan Task 3 item 5 ('replaced in place ... Then it appends'); see the report.

own_limitations: Agency ratings and outlooks are user-supplied in the context file; trigger terms are read from the attached agency source.
Trigger terms are tested at each fiscal year end on CP-2G's reported-basis ratios; agency-adjusted definitions and any condition that a breach be sustained are not modelled.
A trigger is reached only on a strict comparison: a metric equal to its threshold has not reached it and shows zero headroom.
Headroom is the distance still to travel: for an upgrade trigger it is the distance to the level that would meet the term, and a reached upgrade trigger is not a rating change.
Forward headroom is only as reliable as the CP-2G forecast, which uses analyst-assumed drivers.
The migration view is the analyst's judgment on the published terms and the CP-2G path; no probability is computed, no rating is assigned and no agency action is predicted.
The notch difference is measured on the module's fixed combined scale; outlook weighting and sub-notch differences are not modelled.
CP-1D (earnings quality) is not part of this run, so no earnings-quality adjustment is applied to the reported ratios.
Scale positions come from a fixed combined-scale table in the module, not from an agency source.
Rating scope: issuer (S&P).

own_limitations: Agency ratings and outlooks are user-supplied in the context file; trigger terms are read from the attached agency source.
Trigger terms are tested at each fiscal year end on CP-2G's reported-basis ratios; agency-adjusted definitions and any condition that a breach be sustained are not modelled.
A trigger is reached only on a strict comparison: a metric equal to its threshold has not reached it and shows zero headroom.
Headroom is the distance still to travel: for an upgrade trigger it is the distance to the level that would meet the term, and a reached upgrade trigger is not a rating change.
Forward headroom is only as reliable as the CP-2G forecast, which uses analyst-assumed drivers.
The migration view is the analyst's judgment on the published terms and the CP-2G path; no probability is computed, no rating is assigned and no agency action is predicted.
The notch difference is measured on the module's fixed combined scale; outlook weighting and sub-notch differences are not modelled.
CP-1D (earnings quality) is not part of this run, so no earnings-quality adjustment is applied to the reported ratios.
Scale positions come from a fixed combined-scale table in the module, not from an agency source.
The rating date is not stated for S&P.
Rating scope: issuer (S&P).
Rating scope: issuer (Moody's).
The trigger threshold is not stated for S&P downgrade: Free cash flow to total debt: its headroom and timing are Not calculable.
Moody's rating is withdrawn: no notch comparison is made and no trigger terms are published.
A trigger whose metric is not calculable in a forecast year is missing, with the reason, when no earlier year has reached it.
Gap (Material): The free cash flow trigger threshold is not stated and the second agency has withdrawn its rating.
